arguments.message:
Sure thing! To see the exact split between seat charges and usage overages on your invoice:

1. In the Meridian app, go to **Settings → Billing → Invoices**.
2. Open the invoice you need and click the arrow to **expand each line item**. The seat‑charge line will show how many seats were billed and the per‑seat rate, while any overage line will display the metered quantity that exceeded your plan’s allowance.
3. If you prefer a PDF, download it from the same page – the PDF contains the identical itemised breakdown, so you can attach it directly to your budget review.

That will give you the detailed seat‑vs‑overage numbers you need for your meeting.
